infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: DriveScore tracks your location in the background to measure driving trips and calculate your risk score.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DriveScore uses your location to record trip routes and speed.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: DriveScore uses motion sensors to detect driving events like hard braking and sharp turns.
